title: Library
subtitle: Skins, hilts, maps and mods, installed into the client you choose.

clientBar.label: Client
clientBar.hint: Files are installed into this client only. Another client with the same engine keeps its own set. {{game}} clients are listed here; switch game in the sidebar for the other ones.

empty.noClientsText: A library file is installed into a client. Create one and this list starts filling up.
empty.noFilesText: Find skins, hilts, maps and mods on JKHub, then add the pk3 files here. You can also drop them straight onto this window.
empty.filteredText: No file in this client matches the search and the filters. Clear them to see the whole library.
empty.updatesText: Once files carry a JKHub version, the ones with a newer release show up here.

drop.title: Drop pk3 files to install them into {{client}}

conflicts.notice: {{count}} files change the same content. The engine loads the last one and ignores the rest.
conflicts.title: Files that change the same content
conflicts.body: {{files}} archives of {{client}} carry {{paths}} shared paths. The engine reads the last one it loads and ignores the rest.
conflicts.truncated: Only the first {{shown}} of {{total}} paths are listed. Disable one of the archives to see the rest.

remove.title: Remove {{file}} from {{client}}?
remove.body: {{fileName}}, {{size}}. The file is deleted from the client's {{folder}} folder. Other clients keep their own copy.
